title: We studied 16 AI frameworks and imported zero.
hook: We studied 16 AI frameworks as a parts bin, then imported none of them.
thesis: TenantOS started with a forensic pass over sixteen agent frameworks, treating each as a parts bin. The harvest order forbids importing any of them: mechanisms get mapped onto existing authorities first, frameworks never become new sources of truth. It is a genuinely unusual engineering value, and funny enough to travel: mechanisms over frameworks.

verified: Sixteen agent frameworks were studied as a parts bin; the order forbids importing any of them and demands mechanisms be mapped onto existing authorities first (TENANTOS-HARVEST-ORDER.md, via SYSTEMS.md section 3).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
